title: AI-Augmented Adaptive Digital Twin Modeling for Brain Tumor Evolution Prediction and Treatment Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2607.13877v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Brain tumor progression exhibits spatially heterogeneous growth, patient-specific treatment response, and complex interactions with surrounding anatomy, making accurate long-term prediction challenging. We propose an AI-augmented adaptive digital twin (DT) framework for brain tumor evolution prediction and treatment scheduling. The framework integrates an interpretable reaction--diffusion (RD) model, a 3D residual learning module for model-form correction, patient-specific DT updating during recursive rollout, and model predictive control (MPC) for constrained chemotherapy and radiotherapy scheduling. Experiments on 387 synthetic tumor trajectories with 120-step evolution show that the baseline RD model captures tumor location and overall temporal behavior but underestimates heterogeneous tumor burden during long-horizon prediction. Hybrid RD--residual modeling reduces masked voxel-wise mean squared error by 84.3% and increases Dice

translated_title: 面向脑肿瘤演化预测与治疗调度的AI增强自适应数字孪生建模
translated_abstract: 脑肿瘤的进展表现出空间异质性生长、患者特异性的治疗反应以及与周围解剖结构的复杂相互作用，这使得准确的长期预测极具挑战性。我们提出了一种用于脑肿瘤演化预测和治疗调度的AI增强自适应数字孪生（DT）框架。该框架集成了可解释的反应-扩散（RD）模型、用于模型形式校正的3D残差学习模块、递归展开过程中的患者特异性数字孪生更新，以及用于约束性化疗和放疗调度的模型预测控制（MPC）。在387条具有120步演化的合成肿瘤轨迹上进行的实验表明，基线RD模型能够捕捉肿瘤位置和整体时间行为，但在长期预测中会低估异质性肿瘤负荷。混合RD-残差建模将掩码体素均方误差降低了84.3%，并提高了Dice系数。
tldr: 提出了一种AI增强的自适应数字孪生框架，融合可解释反应-扩散模型、3D残差学习、患者特异性更新与模型预测控制，实现了脑肿瘤演化的高精度长期预测以及约束性化疗放疗调度优化。
en_tdlr: Proposes an AI-augmented adaptive digital twin framework integrating interpretable reaction-diffusion modeling, 3D residual learning, patient-specific updating, and model predictive control for accurate long-term brain tumor evolution prediction and constrained chemotherapy and radiotherapy scheduling.
